espn-604009.headline: France need four tries past the man who taught them
beats: England are on 25 points with their pool games done. France have 21 and one game left, so a bonus-point win takes them to the grand final. The four tries have to come through an Argentina defence now run by Shaun Edwards, who used to run France's.
France beat South Africa 21–19 last time out, but with three tries. Argentina conceded 42 to Ireland earlier this month, then held Italy to 14 away a week later.
France lose loosehead Jean-Baptiste Gros, who was named to start and then ruled out. Rodrigue Neti starts instead. Anything short of a win also drops France below Ireland in the world rankings.
If the Edwards system holds, Argentina have plenty of time to enjoy it. Their next game is Canada at the 2027 World Cup.

espn-604010.headline: Wales beat New Zealand; Australia arrive beaten four times
beats: Last Saturday's 35–28 was Wales' first win over New Zealand in 73 years. It followed a 28–21 win over Japan under the same roof. Steve Tandy's side now want three from three this autumn.
Australia beat South Africa 42–38 in September. Since then they have conceded 50 and 43 to New Zealand and 45 to England, then lost 12–15 in Scotland.
Win by 16 or more and Wales go above Australia to eighth in the world. Australia have lost by more than that in three of their last four.

Liam Wright, once Australia's captain, will watch from the stands. His last Test was in July 2024, and his grandfather was from Pembroke Dock. From next summer he could pick either side for the World Cup in Australia. He would prefer a gold jersey, but has not ruled out red.
